artworks.title: The Wooden Bridge at Sulmona, near Tivoli
artworks.artist: Jan Both
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape from an elevated position, showing distant rolling hills and rugged terrain with a winding path. The artwork features intricate brushstrokes creating texture in trees and cliffs. The color palette is monochromatic with black and white shades, accentuating the detailed line work. In the foreground, a path leads to a bridge where figures on horseback cross a stream. The land extends towards the horizon with trees, hills, and a sky with soft clouds.

artworks.title: Henry Somerset, 1st Duke of Beaufort, K.G.
artworks.artist: William Faithorne
artworks.description: The image depicts an individual sitting down from the waist up. The person holds a staff or baton across their body. They have wavy, shoulder-length hair and a subtle mustache and goatee. The individual wears period armor with ornate detailing, including a sash draped across the torso and a ruffled collar. The background features an oval frame with intricate line work surrounding the portrait and an insignia or coat of arms at the bottom center, containing words and heraldic symbols like a shield.

artworks.title: The Triumph of Patience
artworks.artist: Dirck Volckertz Coornhert after Maerten van Heemskerck
artworks.medium: engraving and etching on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an allegorical scene with mythological figures and symbols. The image features various figures with distinctive attributes in a classical style. The central figure is seated on a chariot with ornate wheels, holding a staff, and wearing a helmet. In the background are a tree and a ship. To the left, a winged figure raises a radiant object, accompanied by another figure holding a scythe labeled hope. On the right side, a draped figure balances a wheel. Elaborate drapery and architectural elements enhance the classical style of the scene.

artworks.title: The Triumph of Isaac
artworks.artist: Dirck Volckertz Coornhert after Maerten van Heemskerck
artworks.medium: engraving and etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a man named Isaac riding a saddled camel. Isaac holds a long spear and wears a detailed garment with armor elements. The camel is adorned with a decorated harness and saddle. In the background, there is a mountainous landscape with a settlement and figures. A smaller scene on the right shows figures near a sacrificial altar.

artworks.title: The Triumph of Joseph
artworks.artist: Dirck Volckertz Coornhert after Maerten van Heemskerck
artworks.medium: engraving and etching on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a figure riding a winged bull. The central figure, riding the bull, is adorned in flowing robes and holds a shepherd's crook. The bull has prominent horns and an ornate bridle, and stands with one leg raised. The drawing is highly detailed, showcasing intricate lines and shading. In the background, there are figures with staffs and a gathering of sheep, set beneath a sky with stars and swirling patterns. On the right, another figure grasps the central figure's cloak and another holds a symbolic object towards the forehead. The scene is framed by banners and Latin text.

artworks.title: The Triumph of David
artworks.artist: Dirck Volckertz Coornhert after Maerten van Heemskerck
artworks.medium: engraving and etching on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of armored figures and a lion. The central figure is clad in detailed armor and a crown, holding the lion by its mane. Additional figures in armor surround him, holding banners and spears. The drawing showcases intricate line work and fine detailing, typical of the Renaissance era, with detailed textures on the armor and lion's fur. In the background, there is a landscape with figures and banners, adding depth to the scene. Text at the bottom likely provides context or narrative. The drawing reflects themes of heroism and power.

artworks.title: The Triumph of Job
artworks.artist: Dirck Volckertz Coornhert after Maerten van Heemskerck
artworks.medium: engraving and etching on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a mythological scene. The image depicts a classical, allegorical narrative. Central to the composition is an old man sitting on a large tortoise. The man is muscular, almost nude, and holds a staff. Accompanying him are mythical or allegorical figures. In the background, there is crumbling architecture and dark figures. Latin text at the bottom conveys the message of the scene.

artworks.title: The Triumph of Tobias
artworks.artist: Dirck Volckertz Coornhert after Maerten van Heemskerck
artworks.medium: engraving and etching on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a bearded man riding a donkey while holding a long staff. The man is wearing a flowing cloak and hat. The landscape features another man, a woman, and a shack behind them. The drawing illustrates a narrative scene with intricate detail. The man, identified as Tobias, is depicted riding a donkey, accompanied by a small dog leading the way in the foreground. The woman gestures towards the path, while behind her, a banner with an emblem adds authority to the depiction. The background shows a pastoral setting with trees and architectural structures. In the bottom section of the drawing, there is a piece of Latin text. The composition is rendered with precision in lines, showcasing a classic style, likely influenced by Renaissance art.

artworks.title: The Triumph of Saint Stephen
artworks.artist: Dirck Volckertz Coornhert after Maerten van Heemskerck
artworks.medium: engraving and etching on laid paper
artworks.description: This drawing depicts an elephant and four figures in a landscape. A figure in elaborate clothing is sitting atop the elephant holding a staff. Two muscular figures are on the right, one with a raised fist and the other holding an object. Ethereal figures are above in the clouds, and there is a distant architectural setting. Latin inscriptions are at the bottom of the image.

artworks.title: The Triumph of Christ
artworks.artist: Dirck Volckertz Coornhert after Maerten van Heemskerck
artworks.medium: engraving and etching on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting a regal figure seated on a chariot with various mythological and symbolic elements surrounding it. The scene includes a central crowned figure holding a scepter and waving a flag, seated in a chariot adorned with ornate engravings and symbols. The chariot is pulled by a group of wolves or mythical beasts. Surrounding the figure are several creatures and humanoid figures with distinctive traits. In the background to the left, a scene of crucifixion and ascension is shown, with mountainous terrain and people bearing crosses. The composition is rich in iconography suggesting themes of triumph and eschatology within a complex narrative.

artworks.title: The Apostles Delivered from Prison by an Angel
artworks.artist: Philip Galle after Maerten van Heemskerck
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a biblical scene where an angel is leading a group of prisoners out of captivity. The image shows an architectural structure with arches and a staircase. On the left side, figures in robes with halo adornments are standing closely together, following a central figure who appears to be an angel with wings and a radiant aura. The angel is gesturing forward, leading the figures down a staircase. Guards in armor on the right side of the staircase are depicted in various states of rest or sleep. Other guards are stationed on higher levels of the architecture, and there is a large circular structure resembling a coliseum or amphitheater in the background. The drawing's detailed line work and cross-hatching techniques create a somber and solemn atmosphere.

artworks.title: Robert Walpole, 1st Earl of Orford
artworks.artist: Jacobus Houbraken after Arthur Pond
artworks.description: The image portrays a portrait of a man. He is depicted in a three-quarter view, with his head turned to his left and looking directly at the viewer. The man has long, wavy hair around his face, pronounced eyebrows, a defined nose, and a slight serious expression on his lips. He is wearing a dark coat with a lighter sash, revealing a high-collared, lace-trimmed shirt. An ornate star-shaped emblem is visible on his coat. The background features a detailed oval frame with elaborate carvings and decorative elements like drapery, crowns, and scepters. The illustration is characterized by intricate line work typical of an engraved print.

artworks.title: General Charles Fleetwood
artworks.artist: Jacobus Houbraken after Robert Walker
artworks.description: The image shows an upper-body portrait of a man looking directly at the viewer. He has medium-length, wavy hair falling around his shoulders and distinct facial features. He is dressed in an elaborate suit that resembles armor, with a high white collar. The portrait is surrounded by an ornate frame with baroque-style swirls. Below the portrait, there is a decorative element with a lion resting its paw on a column or scroll. The background is filled with intricate artistic embellishments.

artworks.title: William Russell, 1st Duke of Bedford
artworks.artist: Jacobus Houbraken after Sir Anthony van Dyck
artworks.description: The image shows a bust of a person in an ornate oval frame at the top. The person has distinct facial features, curly dark hair, and is dressed in elaborate clothing. Below the framed portrait is a seated cherubic figure holding a scepter, with rich decorative details surrounding the scene.

artworks.title: Château de Pont-Gibaud
artworks.artist: Eugène Isabey
artworks.description: The image shows an old stone castle on a hill, viewed from a slightly elevated perspective. The castle has towers and is surrounded by smaller buildings. A winding path leads up to the castle from the foreground, with trees and vegetation. The painting has intricate brushstrokes depicting texture in the architecture and landscape. The color palette is monochromatic, using varying shades of black and white to create depth and contrast under a cloudy sky.

artworks.title: Augustin de Thou
artworks.artist: Jean Morin
artworks.description: The image depicts a man in a straight-on position. He has a stern expression with deep-set eyes, a prominent nose, and a slightly furrowed brow. His hair is short and mostly covered by a cap. He is wearing a traditional robe with a thick fur trim. The background is a plain oval frame with text surrounding it. The engraving style gives the portrait a historical and classical appearance.

artworks.title: Christophe de Thou
artworks.artist: Jean Morin
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man in an upright position, gazing forward. He has angular facial features, a slightly furrowed brow, and thin lips. His head is covered by a triangular cap, and he wears a garment with a high fur collar. A ruffled or pleated shirt collar is visible underneath. The background includes an oval border with text reading "MESSIRE CHRISTOPHE DE THOY PREMIER PRESIDENT" and the Roman numeral date "MDLXXVII." The inner background behind the man is textured with lined detailing.

artworks.title: Jean Pierre Camus
artworks.artist: Jean Morin after Philippe de Champaigne
artworks.description: The image shows an older man with a long beard, wearing ecclesiastical robes and a cape. He has distinct facial features such as a high forehead, deep-set eyes, a long nose, and thin lips. His hair is neatly combed back, and he wears a large cross pendant on a long chain around his neck. The background includes a heavily detailed, octagonal frame with engraved text around its perimeter.

artworks.title: Enrag'd Monster
artworks.artist: John Hamilton Mortimer
artworks.description: This is an illustration of a monster. The image depicts a fantastical creature emerging from or residing in the water. The monster has a large, muscular build, with a humanoid upper body and a fish-like lower body. Its face shows a fierce expression, with elongated ears and wild hair. The creature appears to be grappling with a snake or eel-like entity. The water is depicted with dynamic lines. The background includes clouds, creating a dramatic backdrop. The style is intricate, with rich detail and dramatic contrasts.

artworks.title: Veduta dell'Arco di Tito (View of the Arch of Titus)
artworks.artist: Laura Piranesi after Giovanni Battista Piranesi
artworks.description: The image shows the Arch of Titus in a detailed artistic perspective. The arch is prominently featured on the right side, with a low horizon and a clear sky in the background fading into the arch's shadow. The etching technique delicately depicts the stone textures, light, and shadow variations. Figures in historical clothing walk towards the arch, with additional ruins visible in the distance. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of sepia and black to create depth and contrast, highlighting the arch's grandeur and significance.

artworks.title: Catalogo delle Opere
artworks.artist: Giovanni Battista Piranesi
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring intricate architectural elements and text. The left side shows a highly decorated pillar with sculpted motifs, the central area contains formal script, and the right side includes a smaller illustration of a cityscape with classical buildings and a distant dome structure. The composition is detailed and well-organized, demonstrating the artist's skill in combining text and imagery.

artworks.title: Veduta del Tempio di Antonino, oggi Dogana di Terra (View of the Temple of Antoninus, now the Land Customs Office)
artworks.artist: Laura Piranesi after Giovanni Battista Piranesi
artworks.description: The image depicts a street lined with a grand classical building featuring columns and detailed architectural elements. The viewer's vantage point is at street level, offering a view of other buildings along the street. The perspective does not show the horizon clearly due to the towering structures. The fine lines and detailed texture of the print add depth to the scene. The monochromatic color scheme in black and white creates contrasts, highlighting the architecture. A cartwheel is visible in the foreground, and some people are seen in the scene, adding a sense of activity. The buildings extend into the distance, with subtle strokes indicating the sky above.

artworks.title: Portrait of Two Gentlemen
artworks.artist: Frank Short, after Sir Joshua Reynolds
artworks.description: The image shows an upper-body portrait of two men seated closely together. The man on the left is leaned against the back of a chair, with a prominent nose, a slightly upward-curving mouth, and short, wavy hair. He wears a dark coat with a light ruffled collar and his right hand is rested near his chest. The man on the right is turned slightly towards his companion, holding a rectangular object that resembles a framed picture or a book. He has curly hair, is looking downward, and wears a light, open-collared shirt under a darker coat. In front of him are rolled-up papers. The background is plain, emphasizing the figures in the foreground.

artworks.title: Scipio Africanus
artworks.artist: Schelte Adams Bolswert after Sir Peter Paul Rubens
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a historical or mythological scene in a classical setting. The scene depicts a gathering in which figures appear to engage in a formal presentation or exchange in a grand architectural setting with columns and drapery. The central figure, seated, extends a hand towards a standing figure, who is in a gesture of receipt or address. Surrounding them are other figures, both men and women, dressed in elaborate classical clothing. The details, such as ornate vessels and weaponry, add to the regality and historical context of the scene. The setting is embellished with meticulous detailing in fabric and architecture.
